acceptanceCriteria: Both call sites include go list stderr in the failure message
A test with a deliberately broken module shows the go list error text
body: Found by scopes-1021c lane. Test helpers in internal/structureddata containment_test and cmd/corvint cem_test run go list and drop stderr, so a toolchain or module error surfaces as an empty or confusing result.

title: go list call sites in tests discard stderr, hiding why package listing failed
